provenance.encodes: The Indigo Book, R21.1 (Federal Bills and Resolutions)
provenance.how_to_verify: Open the Indigo Book (https://law.resource.org/pub/us/code/blue/IndigoBook.html, CC0), R21.1 (Federal Bills and Resolutions), and compare the form and examples with this pattern.

positive.text: The budget was H.R. Con. Res. 85, 113th Cong. (2013).
Compare H.R. Con. Res. 71 with H.R. Con. Res. 290, 106th Cong. § 2.

negative: The House Concurrent Resolution passed in 2015.
H.R. Con. Res. numbers restart each Congress, 114 times over.
The 114th Cong. adopted the house concurrent resolution.

note: us.fed.legislative.bill does not read the H.R.- and S. Exec.-prefixed resolution abbreviations of R21.1. The key is the govinfo bill type (hconres), the same as us.fed.legislative.bill's for the H.-prefixed form. url_templates: govinfo link service, verified by HTTP fetch on 2026-10-23: https://www.govinfo.gov/link/bills/114/hconres/27 redirects to the bill PDF (103d Congress on).
